wynnvoicechat.consent.title: WynnVoiceChat Voice Chat
wynnvoicechat.consent.notSvc: WynnVoiceChat uses your installed Simple Voice Chat mod, but it is a separate mod. Do NOT contact Simple Voice Chat support. Report any issues to the WynnVoiceChat maintainer.
wynnvoicechat.consent.position: While voice is on, your position is sent to the WynnVoiceChat relay so audio can be routed to nearby players.
wynnvoicechat.consent.recording: The last 2 minutes of your speech are held in the relay's memory. They are saved only if another player reports you, and only for moderation.
wynnvoicechat.consent.moderation: Block someone with %1$s block <player>. Report someone with %1$s report <player> [reason]. Reports go to the WynnVoiceChat maintainer, not to Wynncraft staff.
wynnvoicechat.consent.audience: By default only your party can hear you. Change this with %1$s tier <party|friends_and_guild|everyone>. Cancel turns voice off; you can enable it later with %1$s enable.
wynnvoicechat.consent.everyone.title: Everyone Audience
wynnvoicechat.consent.everyone.rules: Everyone mode lets any nearby player hear you and lets you hear them, including strangers. Be respectful: no harassment, slurs, threats or spam. Cancel keeps your audience at party only.
wynnvoicechat.consent.everyone.report: If someone breaks the rules, report them with %1$s report <player> [reason]. The last 2 minutes of their speech are saved for the WynnVoiceChat moderators. Block them with %1$s block <player>.
wynnvoicechat.consent.everyone.ban: Breaking these rules gets you banned from WynnVoiceChat. Bans are for the service as a whole, not just for the person you were talking to.
wynnvoicechat.consent.guild.title: Guild Channel
wynnvoicechat.consent.guild.channel: With the guild channel on, every guild member who also turned it on hears you anywhere on Wynncraft, on any world, unless you are in a party. Be respectful: no harassment, slurs, threats or spam.
wynnvoicechat.consent.guild.report: Report abuse with %1$s report <player> [reason]; reports go to the WynnVoiceChat maintainer, not to Wynncraft staff. Your guild's owner and chiefs can mute members in the channel with %1$s guild mute <player> [hours].
wynnvoicechat.consent.guild.leave: Leave the channel at any time with %1$s guild off. Cancel keeps it off.
wynnvoicechat.consent.guild.accept: I understand, join the guild channel
